rules.statement: Execution upon a decree for the recovery of money due on a mortgage can be levied not only on the mortgaged property but also on other property belonging to the deceased mortgagor's estate, even if such property was not mortgaged and is in possession of his sole heir.
rules.supporting_quote: "It seems to me that it is not correct to say that the action contemplated in chapter XLVI. is a pure hypothecary action. If by those words it is meant to describe the action mentioned in section 642 as the mortgagee's action in rem, the description will be opposed to the plain meaning of the words of the action which disclose that the action should in every case be the combination of the action in personam and in rem, because it requires the mortgagor to be made a party although he is not in possession. But if, on the other hand, by those words were meant that the action was confined to the object of realizing the mortgaged property after the death of the mortgagor, What necessity is there to make his representative a party to the action if the property is in the possession of third parties."
